title: Agentic Music Post-Production
abstract: arXiv:2610.29093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce MixAgent, an agentic pipeline for music post-production that follows the workflow of audio engineers to build interpretable and editable mixing plans guided by a reference song. A grouping agent first routes related input tracks, such as drum recordings, into subgroups. A planning agent then uses retrieved examples to choose and order audio effects, such as volume control and reverb, for tracks, subgroups, and the full mix. To refine the mix, a detector identifies what needs correction, and a critic proposes numerical parameter adjustments from tracks to the full mix. In our experiments, prompting recent multimodal models to listen and revise often worsens the mix, making reliable correction a central challenge. We therefore build MixCritic, a dataset of 45,657 repair critiques derived from parameters fitted to professional mixes, and train the critic with supervised fine-tuning followed by preference optimization on rende

translated_title: 智能体驱动的音乐后期制作
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MixAgent，一个用于音乐后期制作的智能体流水线。它遵循音频工程师的工作流程，以参考歌曲为指导，构建可解释且可编辑的混音方案。分组智能体首先将相关的输入音轨（如鼓的录音）归入子组。随后，规划智能体利用检索到的示例，为音轨、子组和整体混音选择并排序音频效果（如音量控制和混响）。为了精修混音，检测器识别需要修正的内容，评审智能体则从音轨到整体混音提出数值参数调整建议。在实验中，我们发现提示最新的多模态模型通过“聆听”来修改混音往往会使混音效果变差，这使得可靠的修正如成为核心挑战。因此，我们构建了MixCritic——一个包含45,657条修复评述的数据集，这些评述源自根据专业混音拟合的参数——并通过监督微调结合偏好优化来训练评审模型。（注：原文摘要末尾被截断）
tldr: 本文提出模仿音频工程师工作流程的智能体混音系统MixAgent，并构建包含45,657条修复评述的MixCritic数据集，通过监督微调与偏好优化训练评审模型，解决了多模态模型直接修改混音常导致效果变差的难题。
en_tdlr: MixAgent is an agentic music mixing pipeline that mimics audio engineers' workflows to build interpretable, editable mixing plans, while MixCritic—a 45,657-critique dataset trained via supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization—enables reliable automated mix correction where direct prompting of multimodal models fails.
